x_glider.lore.epic: Circled silently over the beach all afternoon, and every seagull thought it was a giant gull and followed it home.
x_glider.lore.legendary: Stayed up riding warm air for a whole week. When it finally landed, the pilot had grown a beard and the airfield had a new café.

x_seaplane.lore.legendary: Landed on the hotel swimming pool to deliver a birthday cake. The guests kept swimming round its floats as if it were a lilo.

x_space_rocket_toy.lore.epic: Blasted off from the garden with one stamp on the air pump and landed on the school roof. The caretaker now keeps a ladder ready.
x_space_rocket_toy.lore.legendary: Pumped so hard it flew over three gardens and the school, then landed back in its own toy box. Its owner calls this a full orbit.

ambulance.lore.epic: Turned on its siren once at the seaside, and every gull on the beach copied it until sunset.

x_hot_air_balloon.lore.legendary: Floated so high over the mountains that it landed on a summit, and the climbers who had walked up for a week were not pleased.

x_asphalt_paver.lore.uncommon: Leaves a road so warm behind it that every cat in the street comes to lie on it at teatime.

bulldozer.lore.rare: Pushed a skip, a shed and the foreman's lunch into the same pile before noticing anyone was shouting.

x_grader.lore.legendary: Cleared a mountain pass of snow with one sweep of its blade, then left a perfectly neat snowman at the top.

x_road_roller.lore.epic: Rolled over a forgotten garden hose and sprayed the whole street like a giant fountain until teatime.

x_skid_steer.lore.uncommon: Swaps its bucket for forks, a brush or a drill in seconds, and swaps just to show off.

x_steamroller.lore.epic: Steamed up the whole village green so thickly that the fête carried on in fog, and three people bought the same cake twice.
x_steamroller.lore.legendary: Rolled flat a road made entirely of conkers so the village could have a smooth autumn. The squirrels have not forgiven it.

x_wheel_loader.lore.epic: Moved every gravel pile in the quarry in one day, and the quarry manager spent the evening looking for his car under one.

bus.lore.epic: Took a wrong turn on the school trip and brought forty children to the zoo instead of the museum. Nobody has complained.

i_car_wheel.lore.epic: Got stuck in a giant puddle at the roundabout and sent a wave over every car going round, twice.
i_car_wheel.lore.legendary: Did a million turns without a single puncture, and the garage gave it a gold hubcap. It lost it in a hedge the same day.

i_disk_brake.lore.epic: Stopped so suddenly at the zebra crossing that every car behind stopped too, all the way back to the next town.

i_gas_pump.lore.epic: Ran dry on the holiday weekend, and the queue of cars stretched past the motorway sign, the service station and a farm.
i_gas_pump.lore.legendary: Clicked off at exactly the round number for every customer for a whole summer, and drivers queued from three towns away to watch.

i_grille.lore.epic: Breathed in so hard through its slats on the motorway that it swallowed a kite, three crisp packets and somebody's sun hat.
i_grille.lore.legendary: Grinned at a grumpy traffic jam until every driver grinned back, and the jam cleared itself out of embarrassment.

i_horse_cart.lore.epic: Took the wrong lane at market and led every car in town round the duck pond twice at walking pace.
i_horse_cart.lore.legendary: Carried a whole wedding party across the flooded ford without a single wet shoe, and the horse got the first slice of cake.

i_model_t.lore.legendary: Was driven home from the museum by mistake and did the school run for a week before anyone noticed.

i_oxcart.lore.legendary: Arrived so late at the harvest fair that it became the first cart at next year's fair. The ox calls this planning.

x_cherry_picker.lore.legendary: Reached the clock tower to fix the clock and turned the hands back an hour, so the whole town got a lie-in it never asked for.

x_scissor_lift.lore.common: Beeps the whole time it goes up, the whole time it goes down, and a little bit after.
x_scissor_lift.lore.legendary: Raised a dancer so high in the school play that she finished the dance on the theatre roof, to cheers from the pigeons.

dump_truck.lore.rare: Tipped its load on the wrong drive, and a family came home to a mountain of gravel where their car used to be.

x_backhoe_loader.lore.legendary: Dug holes with one end and planted trees with the other all down the high street in one night. The town woke up in a forest.

excavator.lore.uncommon: Scratches its own back with its bucket, and sometimes uses it to wave at the crane.

fire_truck.lore.common: Fills its tank at the hydrant and soaks the firefighter holding the hose, every single time.
fire_truck.lore.legendary: Put out a bonfire, a burning barbecue and a birthday cake in one afternoon, and the birthday boy has never forgiven it.

garbage_truck.lore.epic: Crunched the whole festival's rubbish in one night, including the stage, two tents and the mayor's deckchair.
garbage_truck.lore.legendary: Swallowed a wedding ring by mistake, then crunched through a whole mountain of rubbish to give it back before the cake was cut.

x_atv.lore.legendary: Crossed every muddy field in the county in one day and came home so muddy that the farmer planted potatoes on it.

go_kart.lore.legendary: Drove so many laps one summer that it came round again before its own tyre smoke had cleared, and overtook itself.

x_quad_bike.lore.epic: Raced across every field on the farm towing a trailer of hay, and left a trail so long that the cows followed it into the farmhouse kitchen.
x_quad_bike.lore.legendary: Rounded up a thousand sheep in one morning, then did it all again because the sheepdog wanted another go.

x_quad_tractor.lore.common: Leaves enormous muddy tyre prints all the way down the lane, so everyone knows exactly where it went for lunch.
x_quad_tractor.lore.epic: Rolled into the village fête and towed the bouncy castle, the tea tent and the tombola to the next field when it rained.

helicopter.lore.uncommon: Lands on a big painted H and refuses to land anywhere without one, even on the beach.
helicopter.lore.epic: Hovered over the zoo for a news report, and every parrot learned to say whup-whup-whup.

i_flagpole.lore.legendary: Flew a flag so high on the school's birthday that a passing airliner dipped its wings, and the whole school waved back.

i_harvester.lore.uncommon: Has a long spout that pours grain into the trailer, and sometimes into the farmer's hat.
i_harvester.lore.legendary: Harvested a field in the shape of a giant smiley face, and airline pilots now wave at it on their way past.

i_hay.lore.legendary: Was rolled into a bale so big that the farm used it as a guest house for a family of mice, two hens and a very lazy dog.

i_manhole_cover.lore.epic: Was lifted for an inspection, and every tennis ball lost in the last fifty years bounced up out of the sewer onto the street.
i_manhole_cover.lore.legendary: Was so heavy that the strongest man in town tried to lift it, and it lifted him instead. It still has his handprint.

i_mobile_home.lore.rare: Hit a pothole so hard that every cupboard opened and the breakfast cereal ended up in the shower.
i_mobile_home.lore.epic: Got stuck in the gateway of the campsite, so the whole family had their holiday right there in the lane.
i_mobile_home.lore.legendary: Stayed at the campsite so long that the town gave it a postcode, a postman and a bus stop outside.

i_pedestal.lore.epic: Was put out by mistake without its statue, and visitors spent a month admiring the empty pedestal as modern art.
i_pedestal.lore.legendary: Held up a statue so still for so long that the pigeons decided it was the safest roof in the city and moved in for good.

i_pole.lore.epic: Held up so many festival lights that the high street could be seen from the next town, and moths came from three counties.
i_pole.lore.legendary: Was bumped into by a hundred thousand people looking at their phones, and finally got a phone of its own to stare back at them.

i_shield.lore.epic: Was used as a sledge by every child in the castle, and reached the village at the bottom before the knights did.
i_shield.lore.legendary: Bounced a catapulted cabbage back so hard that it landed in the enemy's soup, and the battle stopped for lunch.

i_thresher.lore.legendary: Threshed so fast that the grain shot out through the barn roof, and the hens had breakfast delivered from the sky for a month.

i_turnstile.lore.rare: Spun so fast in the rush that it sent commuters onto the wrong platform, still holding their coffee.
i_turnstile.lore.legendary: Spun round so many times in one rush hour that it wound the station clock forward, and everyone got home early.

ice_cream_truck.lore.rare: Played its tune so sweetly that every child on the estate came out in slippers, even the ones in the bath.
ice_cream_truck.lore.legendary: Kept its freezer so cold in a heatwave that the penguins at the zoo asked to move in.

x_escalator.lore.rare: Swallowed a shoelace at the top and kept the shoe as a souvenir. The lost property office is now mostly left shoes.

motorcycle.lore.legendary: Rode the longest road in the world from top to bottom, and arrived with the same fly still stuck to its visor.

pickup.lore.legendary: Carried a whole barn across the valley one plank at a time in one weekend, and the cows inside never noticed.

police_car.lore.rare: Turned on its lights to stop the traffic for a family of ducks, then escorted them all the way to the pond.
police_car.lore.legendary: Caught a runaway hot-air balloon by its rope and towed it gently back to the fair, with the passengers still waving.

x_satellite_model.lore.legendary: Beeped so convincingly during space week that the headteacher cancelled maths in case it was a real message from space.

x_barge.lore.legendary: Was so long that its front reached the next lock before its back had left the last one, and the lock keeper had to open both at once.

x_dinghy.lore.uncommon: Has a daggerboard that slides up and down, and it always slides up exactly when you need it down.
x_dinghy.lore.rare: Sailed so close to the swans that it accidentally joined their family, and now gets fed bread every Sunday.
x_dinghy.lore.legendary: Sailed across the whole bay with only a beach towel for a sail, and arrived before the ferry.

x_ferry.lore.common: Blows its foghorn the moment you've finally balanced your tea on the rail.
x_ferry.lore.epic: Carried a whole travelling funfair across the bay, and the big wheel kept turning for the entire crossing.

x_fishing_boat.lore.legendary: Caught a boot, a bicycle and a treasure chest in one net, and the treasure turned out to be somebody's old socks.

i_gondola.lore.rare: Got its pole stuck in the mud, and the gondolier was left hanging on the pole while the gondola drifted off to dinner.

x_houseboat.lore.epic: Grew so many tomatoes on its roof that the whole river had salad for a summer, and the ducks complained about the onions.

i_lifeboat.lore.legendary: Rowed out through a hurricane to rescue a stranded sailor, who turned out to be a very grateful seal.

x_rowboat.lore.legendary: Was hired for one hour by a very slow rower and came back three weeks later with a family of geese living in it.

sailboat.lore.legendary: Sailed round the whole world without an engine, and came home with a postcard from every country stuck to its sail.
sailboat.lore.epic: Caught a gust so big in the harbour that it towed three crab nets, a fishing line and a very surprised windsurfer out to sea.

x_tugboat.lore.epic: Tooted so proudly at the harbour festival that every ship in port tooted back, and the town's windows rattled till midnight.

x_yacht.lore.legendary: Was so big that it brought its own little yacht along, and that one had a little yacht too.

school_bus.lore.legendary: Drove so gently over the speed bumps for a whole term that the egg-and-spoon team practised on the back seat and never dropped one.

x_rickshaw.lore.legendary: Pedalled up the steepest hill in the city with a piano in the back, and the passenger played it all the way up.
x_rickshaw.lore.epic: Carried home so many shoppers on festival day that its bell wore out, and it had to shout ding instead.

x_tuk_tuk.lore.rare: Leaned so far round a corner on two wheels that the passengers shook hands with a fruit seller.

x_roller_skate.lore.legendary: Danced so well at the roller disco that the mirror ball came down from the ceiling to join in.

x_segway.lore.legendary: Went the whole length of the coast on one charge, then leaned forward one last time and rolled into the sea for a paddle.
